notes.subject: ופריץ חיות
notes.rationale: 'violent one of beasts' — ol i tanim olsem 'ravenous beast' o 'beast of prey'; tok פריץ em i man bilong pait gutpela tumas, i no animal yet

notes.subject: גאולים
notes.rationale: גאל em i pasin bilong klostu famili i baim bek man — 'ol man Yahwe i baim bek olgeta', i no 'redeemed' nating

notes.subject: שם ... שם
notes.rationale: tupela 'long hap' i ritim olsem echoes, wanpela long stat, wanpela long taim ol ga'ulim i wokabaut

translation: Laion i no bai stap long hap, na ol animal nogut bilong pait i no ken go antap long en; ol i no bai painim ⟨ol⟩ long hap; tasol ol man Yahwe i baim bek olgeta, ol i wokabaut long en.

tokens.gloss: ol man Yahwe i baim bek olgeta
